label: Ten synthetic coding requests (macOS Samantha voice)
vocabulary: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, shadcn, Vitest, Playwright, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Prisma, Zod, pnpm, GitHub Actions, pi-dictate, OAuth

samples.text: Add a dark mode toggle to the settings page and run the tests.
Convert the React component to TypeScript and fix the type errors.
Use Tailwind CSS to make the layout work on mobile.
Add a shadcn dialog and validate the form with Zod.
Write Vitest tests for the parser and Playwright tests for the login flow.
Connect Prisma to PostgreSQL and apply the migration.
Update the Supabase client without changing the OAuth callback.
Run pnpm install and fix the GitHub Actions workflow.
Keep pi-dictate local and do not send the prompt automatically.
Please do not delete the cache or rename the authentication module.
